text:
sasha_cs: FYI Cedarwell just sent back their vendor security form. They flagged SOC2 evidence + backup encryption details and asked for an incident-notification SLA. Renewal in ~6 weeks — want to make sure this doesn't become a blocker. :eyes:
onboard-bot: New form submitted: https://forms.internal/cedarwell-2026 (auto-attached PDF). Fields: SOC2 report (requested), backup encryption, incident notif SLA, subprocessors list.
olivia_sec: thanks for the ping. can you drop which fields are missing vs what they've accepted?
sasha_cs: Missing: SOC2 report (they asked for latest Type II), specific backup-at-rest encryption algo, incident notif timeline (they expect <48h), and an answered subprocessor list. They left a freeform asking about BYOK.
miguel_eng: if they want BYOK that escalates — we can show KMS integrations but not hand off keys. maybe propose envelope encryption + KMS logs as evidence.
chris_csm: renewal team flagged this as medium risk if we can't produce docs within 10 business days. Can we gather a short evidence packet and schedule a 30m call with their security lead?
olivia_sec: I can draft answers for SOC2 + incident notif. Draft suggestion: "We maintain SOC2 Type II for our production controls; attached is redacted report. Incident notifications: initial acknowledgement within 24h, full impact assessment within 72h, remediation plan within 10 business days." Thoughts?
miguel_eng: neutral on the timelines — 24h ack and 72h assessment is fine. For BYOK, say: "We support customer-managed keys in Private deployments and provide KMS attestations; for hosted accounts we offer strict access controls and audit logs but do not accept external key import".
sasha_cs: perfect. can you put that into a one-pager and attach the redacted SOC2? i'll send to Cedarwell and book a slot.
chris_csm: i'll nudge renewal to extend the internal review window by a week if they need more time. also, can we offer a brief enablement/demo on data handling to calm them? :calendar:
olivia_sec: i'll prepare the one-pager + redacted SOC2 snippet and upload to the form thread by EOD. includes: 1) SOC2 redacted, 2) encryption summary (algos + KMS logs), 3) incident SLA text, 4) subprocessor inventory link.
miguel_eng: i'll export KMS audit sample and the encryption config snippet: ```json
{"disk_encryption":"AES-256-GCM","kms_provider":"aws-kms","key_rotation":"90 days"}
```
sasha_cs: thanks — once uploaded i'll reply and propose Tue 10am PST for a 30m call. chris, flag renewal as 'watch' not yet 'at-risk'.
onboard-bot: Reminder set: follow up with Cedarwell on 4951234567 in 72 hours.
chris_csm: ack. also capturing feedback: Cedarwell asked for clearer onboarding docs re: backup and key handling — can we add a short FAQ to enablement? small UX win for renewals.
miguel_eng: happy to add a 2-slide FAQ to the onboarding deck. tagging @product to review later.
sasha_cs: great collaborative plan. i'll update the account health dashboard and ping here once sent. :thumbsup:
